source.name: Mapzen / AWS Terrain Tiles, Terrarium zoom 5
source.processing: Decoded numeric heights, reprojected from EPSG:3857 to a regular EPSG:4326 grid by bilinear interpolation, rounded to integer meters. Includes bathymetry. No synthetic relief or vertical exaggeration.
source.gridRegistration: vertices inclusive of bounds; longitude = west + column/(width-1)*(east-west); latitude = north - row/(height-1)*(north-south)
source.attribution: Mapzen Terrain Tiles. Global GMTED2010 and SRTM terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; global ETOPO1 terrain data from the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
